sides.method: per block from its own tickets (house number parity, 2+ ticket lead and 70%), else the nearest decided block of the same street and route (up to 8 blocks), else its single ticket, else both days on both sides

crossCheck.reading: sameSide = the ticket's side is swept that weekday, week and hour (15 min slack); otherSideOnly = only the opposite side is (mostly an address written for the other side of the street); blockNoRuleThen = the block is in the data but nothing is swept then; blockNotInData = the block has no rules

holidays: City holidays: no sweeping and no make-up day (StreetsLA calendar). Tickets on the 26 City holidays of 2025-26: 6
